intro: Recovered from infiltrating spies near Ironband's Compound, the Underground Map reveals clandestine tunnel networks burrowing toward the roots of Ironforge. Its jagged Dark Iron runes outline a stealthy subterranean route piercing straight toward ancient chambers beneath the mountain. Delivering it to Earthseer Farsen marks the first step in uncovering an impending invasion below.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.
